title: Reject rolled-over dates in storage sensor logs
source: lib/ohworks-storage-conditions.ts:148-149 accepts Z-suffixed Date.parse values and :215-216 trusts that helper. Inline reproduction: one refrigerated reading at 2026-02-30T12:00:00Z with 4 C, 0 lux, 40 percent humidity returns usable=true. Planning verification on ef1f4da1633e6d4e90348ea613055691f1131580: the eight assigned existing test files passed 291/291 tests using TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 node --import /private/tmp/actorlab-654-review-base/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --test followed by their exact paths (read-only existing loader; no dependency installation). All eight defect reproductions were separately asserted inline against unchanged source. Standalone source-verified bug; reviewed held issues #72, #94, #95 are not fully closed by this change.
prompt:
Validate actual calendar dates in the synthetic storage-condition log. lib/ohworks-storage-conditions.ts:148-149 currently accepts any Z-suffixed string that Date.parse can normalize. validateReading at lines 209-217 delegates timestamp acceptance to that helper. An inline reproduction with one refrigerated reading at 2026-02-30T12:00:00Z, temperatureC=4, lightLux=0, and humidityPercent=40 returned usable=true. The log therefore presents an impossible observation date as valid storage evidence.

Replace the local timestamp predicate with validation of the declared UTC ISO timestamp's calendar and clock fields before parsing. Check month lengths and leap years and reject rolled-over dates. Retain the existing requirement for a Z suffix and support ordinary timestamps with and without fractional seconds. Invalid readings must raise StorageConditionLogError with reading-timestamp-invalid and the original reading index. Preserve chronological ordering checks, storage bands, severity thresholds, excursion grouping, and usable decisions for valid logs.

Extend tests/ohworks/storage-conditions.test.ts with February 30, April 31, a non-leap February 29, a valid leap-day control, and malformed clock fields. Put an invalid timestamp after a valid reading to verify the reported index. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/storage-conditions.test.ts. work on the assigned branch you are on. Keep fixtures synthetic and changes within the two allowed files; no merges, rebases, commits, pushes, database access, deployments, credentials, or external services.
